task_text: Conveyor pick, carriage load, braking and dock unload: At the start a small cube (the part) rides along a powered roller conveyor, and a shallow carriage is already coasting along a frictionless rail. Grasp the part with the gripper while it is moving and lift it; set it on the moving carriage and let go while the carriage is still moving; then grip the carriage's vertical handle with both fingers and bring the carriage to a stop, with the part still on it, before it reaches the end of its rail; grasp the part again and lift it off the carriage; finally set it down in a fixed dock and leave it there at rest. Phases, in order: moving_acquisition: at some step both fingers (left and right) touch the part while the part moves faster than 0.025 m/s; then, with both fingers still touching it, the part's centre is above world z = 0.20 m.; loaded_carriage_release: the part touches the carriage's moving body, is not held by both fingers (at most one finger touches it), and the carriage moves along its rail faster than `release_min_speed` = 0.025 m/s, all at the same step.; handle_braking: both fingers grip the carriage's handle, the carriage moves slower than 0.012 m/s, the part's centre is within 0.07 m of the carriage centre along both carriage-frame x and y (the carriage frame is world-aligned), and the part touches the carriage, for 0.25 s without interruption. Gripping the handle means, at each physics step: both fingers (each with its pad) touch the carriage's moving body, and every finger-carriage contact point of that step lies on the handle (within 2 mm of the handle block, the tall 28 x 36 x 76 mm box at the carriage's +x end), with both fingers pressing on it (a summed handle impulse above 1e-7 N s each). A finger touching the carriage's walls or floor at that step (a contact point carrying an impulse of at least 1e-9 N s) breaks the grip.; payload_regrasp: both fingers touch the part, its centre is above world z = 0.20 m, and it does not touch the carriage.; dock_deposit: the part is not held by both fingers, touches the dock, its centre is within 0.04 m (horizontal distance) of the dock's centre, and it moves slower than 0.03 m/s, for 0.5 s without interruption. This completes the task. Goal geometry: Lift height: the part's centre above world z = 0.20 m (moving_acquisition and payload_regrasp). Spill height: world z = 0.09 m (handle_braking and payload_regrasp). The delivery target is the dock's centre (a physical fixture).
episode: one episode, no reset: it ends at the first control step where the task has succeeded (every phase in order) or failed (a failure event, a forbidden contact, a safety-limit violation, an object out of bounds, or the task's horizon of 25 s of simulated time, 2500 control steps), when your time is up, or on a simulator error; the simulated clock advances only with the control steps you run
